data.narrative:
Muon Space is a Series B-stage space technology company that has raised $250M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, Skyryse) alongside a broader public peer set of 5 Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $250M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implies $475M. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 private comparables yields $1.6B, with the peer set ranging from $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures, which private companies rarely provide.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $404M to $1.9B, with a median of $1.1B. The wide spread reflects meaningful dispersion in peer valuations within the frontier space sector, likely driven by differences in technology maturity and market positioning among competitors. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peer set and the appropriate stage-up multiplier given market conditions.
